adaptive_momentum.description: Every month takes up to three of the strongest funds by their average return over 3, 6 and 12 months. Only funds that are rising and trade above their 200-day average qualify, one per group and not too similar to each other. An empty slot waits in the cash fund. When the chosen funds swung more than the target volatility over the last month, part of the money goes to the cash fund so the portfolio's risk stays steady. Between rebalances the strategy sells nothing on stops: in history such sales locked in the bottom more often than they saved from a fall.
adaptive_momentum.report.rebalance.name: Rebalance
adaptive_momentum.report.rebalance.descr: Picks the funds for the next month, sizes the share of money in funds by volatility and says what to buy and sell.
